models_evaluated: object detection algorithm with self-supervised lesion ranking (ugly duckling tool)

links.outcome: Dermatologist confidence and agreement with top-10 AI-identified ugly ducklings when assisted by the tool
links.effect: Tool increased dermatologists' confidence in diagnosis; average majority agreement with top-10 AI-identified ugly ducklings reached 100% when assisted.
links.quote: The study also found that the tool increased dermatologists' confidence when formulating a diagnosis, and the average majority agreement with the top-10 AI-identified UDs reached 100% when assisted by our tool.

screen.reason: The study tests an AI decision-support tool in a reader/validation study with dermatologists, evaluating diagnostic confidence and agreement with vs. without AI assistance.
